method:
PF-5C manual review: every Plan F-served answer of the P1, PF-4 held-out, PF-5B fresh and PF-5C fresh sets (guide or handbook)
and every P0 answer.

A hand verdict (CORRECT / ACCEPTABLE BUT LIMITED / WRONG) is bound to the SHA-256 (first 16 hex digits) of the exact answer
text that was read against the official page, so a verdict never carries over to a changed answer: a served answer whose
hash differs, or that has no verdict, gets none and fails ``analyze.py``. P0 answers keep the PF-3D verdict, P1 answers the PF-4
verdict and the PF-5B reviewed answers their PF-5B verdict, only when the rendered answer is byte-identical. The PF-5C verdicts
are in ``hand_verdicts.json`` (id -> answer sha256[:16], verdict, note).

Writes ``p1_regression.json``, ``fresh_held_out_review.json``, ``fresh_held_out_results.json``, ``p0_regression.json`` and the
review table that ``analyze.py`` reads.

    python -X utf8 qa/post_freeze_pf5c/make_review.py <results.json> <out dir> <review table out>
